cursor.frontmatter:
name: reply-brief
description: >-
  Answers in ordinary prose: integrate the point, drop anything the reader
  does not need, and choose paragraphs, lists, or tables by what is easiest
  to read. Does not force a fixed field template. Use when the user names
  reply-brief, wants a direct answer, asks 为什么 / 怎么回事 / 能不能 /
  够不够, or when no row of the product table matches and the message is not
  a code change (catch-all).
disable-model-invocation: true
